rows.note: Use 同意 as the all-purpose noun for agreement or consent.

example.english: We need our family's concurrence before we can get married.
example.traditional: 我哋要攞到屋企人嘅同意先可以結婚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lo2 dou3 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 tung4 ji3 sin1 ho2 ji5 git3 fan1

rows.note: Use 巧合 when the simultaneous occurrence is presented as a coincidence, especially a concurrence of accidents.

example.english: The concurrence of the two accidents was a real coincidence.
example.traditional: 兩宗意外竟然同時發生，真係巧合。
example.jyutping: loeng5 zung1 ji3 ngoi6 ging2 jin4 tung4 si4 faat3 sang1 zan1 hai6 haau2 hap6
